scientific_integrity: The two frozen epoch spectra and the uniform conditional norm-growth bound are proved analytically from a positive-definite rational quadratic form certificate. Finite checks support the specified identities only.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two centered scalar quadratic components, unreset momentum, constant learning rate and exact arithmetic. The Euclidean two-iterate state result concerns expected square, not almost-sure divergence or general learning-rate regions.
title: Uniform mean-square amplification under fresh reshuffling of two stable heavy-ball epoch orders
